name: MITgcm-LLC4320 (12 sampled regions)
size_as_stated: ~10,000 samples given from all regions combined
resolution: 1/48° native resolution, coarsened to 1/12°, 1/8°, 1/4°, 1/2°, 1°; 12-hour time averages over 14 months (Sep 2011 to Nov 2012)
access: Variables from the LLC4320 output in the regions used in this study are stored on the LEAP-Catalog https://catalog.leap.columbia.edu/feedstock/highresolution-ocean-simulation-llc4320-12hourly-averaged-3d-regions. Data from the LLC4320 simulation can be accessed using the llcreader Python package (Abernathey, 2019).

scales.note: Twelve 15x15 degree regions sampled from 1/48 deg LLC4320, 12-hourly averaged and coarse-grained up to 1 deg over 14 months.
